verdict.rationale: Meilisearch positions its full-text search as fast and instant ("find what they want instantly"). It pairs with React InstantSearch for responsive as-you-type interfaces, and documents a facet-search endpoint for type-ahead. Independent users report search 3x faster than Elasticsearch and "searches are fast" even at 80M documents. One user measured ~360ms on a third-party deployment and questioned the "instant" claim, but that single network-inclusive sample does not concretely refute the capability. Missing for 10: explicit docs on per-keystroke prefix matching for main search, published millisecond latency benchmarks for text search (the only "milliseconds" claim concerns image search), and independent latency measurements confirming sub-100ms responses.
